text:
ben_sales: Hey team — we're in final SIG run with NorthStar Bank. They want per-question evidence; deadline EOD Fri. Key asks: KMS rotation policy, SOC2 report, VPC peering diagram, on-prem options. Can security owner help consolidate? @elaine_security
elaine_security: On it. Can you drop their SIG spreadsheet and any specific question IDs? I'll map evidence. Also need contact at NorthStar for clarifications. :thumbsup:
ben_sales: Uploaded their spreadsheet to drive: https://drive.redwood/northstar/sig2026 (view only). Questions they flagged: 3.2 (key rotation), 5.1 (endpoint auth), 8.4 (data resid.)
elaine_security: Good. For 3.2 we can provide KMS rotation policy + KMS config screenshot. For 5.1 we'll need auth flow diagram and a snippet of our token validation code. I can provide redacted logs for 8.4. ETA 24h.
marcus_eng: For KMS rotation: we rotate CMKs every 90 days; envelope keys rotated per deploy. Snippet of rotation cron:
```bash
# rotate KEK every 90 days
0 3 */90 * * /opt/redwood/bin/rotate_kms_keys --key-group inference
```
I'll attach key-policy diff and KMS ARN list.
olivia_se: I'll package SOC2 Type II summary and CAIQ mapping. Note: SOC2 full report is under NDA — we can provide SOC2 letter and redacted control mapping. Link: https://drive.redwood/compliance/soc2_2025_redacted.pdf
raj_devex: Quick note: For 5.1 token validation code lives in repo infra/authn. We can paste the small middleware snippet:
```python
def validate_token(token):
    # verify signature, expiry, scopes
    # returns claims or raises
    ...
```
I can sanitize and add to the evidence bundle.
ben_sales: Perfect. Customer asked about private deployment (on-prem) network diagrams. Elaine — do we have a template topology with VPC/peering and HSM notes?
elaine_security: Yes — template under compliance/templates/vpc-topology.png. We'll include HSM usage: "optional HSM integration via AWS CloudHSM or on-prem HSM using PKCS#11 adapter" and note KMS rotation still enforced.
ben_sales: Also pricing question: they asked if Dedicated can be committed monthly. I'll follow up with finance, but want to note that Dedicated SLA and audit costs may be in the contract. @olivia_se can you flag pricing impact in the evidence pack?
olivia_se: On it, I'll add a one-pager clarifying Dedicated commit flexibility and where to route contract exceptions. Will annotate any audit fees.
dev-bot: doc_uploader: Evidence bundle "northstar_sig_evidence_2026.zip" uploaded to https://drive.redwood/northstar/northstar_sig_evidence_2026.zip
elaine_security: Thanks everyone — I'll assemble final ZIP with a question->evidence index and drop it back here. If anyone has redacted items, DM me by 16:00 PST. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
ben_sales: Appreciate it. I'll loop legal once the zip is ready. Closing for now.
